name: input
title: Input
description: Form-associated single-line text and number field for primary and secondary application backgrounds, with native input behavior, four control densities, optional leading and trailing content, search clearing, and validation.

intent.summary: Form-associated single-line text and number field for primary and secondary application backgrounds, with native input behavior, four control densities, optional leading and trailing content, search clearing, and validation.
useWhen: A user must enter or edit one line of text, an email address, telephone number, URL, search query, password, or exact number.
The value must participate in native, Angular, React, or Vue form state.
A compact filter or toolbar needs a single-line search field that follows the shared control-density recipe.
avoidWhen: The user chooses from a finite set of known values.
The user must enter multiple paragraphs or formatted content.
The value is adjusted primarily by dragging within a numeric range.

alternatives.when: The value comes from a finite set of known choices.
alternatives.reason: Select exposes the available values and owns listbox selection behavior.

alternatives.when: The value is an immediate on/off setting.
alternatives.reason: Switch communicates a binary setting instead of free text entry.

alternatives.when: The value is chosen from a bounded numeric range.
alternatives.reason: Slider supports direct range adjustment and communicates the current position.

accessibility: Provide a persistent visible label through the owning field or an external native label; placeholder text is guidance and must not be the field's only label.
Choose the native input type that matches the value so browsers and assistive technology can provide appropriate semantics and keyboards.
Error text is associated with the native input and announced as an alert when the invalid state is rendered.
Read-only fields remain focusable and submittable while preventing edits; inactive or disabled fields leave the tab order and are omitted from form submission.
Number stepper actions are pointer affordances hidden from the accessibility tree; the native spinbutton remains the single keyboard and assistive-technology control.
Suffix content must not carry information that is otherwise absent from the field's visible label, value, or description.
states: Every size applies one complete control-density recipe across frame height, inline padding, icon zones, text-container inset, gap, and radius; supporting error content follows the shared 4px field flow.

The normal field boundary uses the shared secondary inset border. Focus promotes it to the thicker bold-brand inset stroke, while error uses the thicker bold-negative inset stroke without changing geometry. Set hasBorder to false only in chrome that supplies enough surrounding structure; set hasInteractionFill to false when that containing chrome also owns hover and pressed feedback.

Placeholder text is secondary at rest and quaternary while the editable field is focused because it becomes decorative once typing begins. Single-line placeholder and entered value text truncate with an ellipsis when the field is narrower than its content.
Entered values use the parent surface's primary foreground; prefix icons, suffix content, and resting placeholder text use its secondary foreground.
Search fields show a standard borderless CrossCircle icon action only while they contain a value. Clearing emits the empty value and restores focus to the native field.

Search fields disable browser autocomplete history, automatic capitalization, autocorrection, and spellchecking by default so browser-owned suggestions do not compete with product-owned results. Consumers can explicitly provide autoComplete when a different native history behavior is required.

Search fields used with owned result sets forward aria-controls and aria-activedescendant to the native field so keyboard focus can remain in the query while assistive technology tracks the active result.
The suffix slot is for compact units or decorations. The optional leading icon is decorative and does not replace the field label.
Use autoComplete, inputMode, and enterKeyHint to provide browser and virtual-keyboard hints without changing the value's semantic type.

Number fields preserve native spinbutton semantics, keyboard stepping, and min/max constraint behavior while dsChange continues to report the native string value. Two borderless inset chevron actions split the available inner height, disable independently at their numeric bound, and restore focus to the spinbutton after pointer activation.

textAlign positions the editable value while the numeric stepper stays on the opposite inline edge, keeping the actions clear of the number: start-aligned values use an inline-end stepper and end-aligned values use an inline-start stepper.
The host exposes focused, filled, dirty, touched, invalid, disabled, read-only, and required data attributes for Field integration and diagnostics.
Use Input only on primary or secondary application backgrounds. It intentionally does not expose alternate surface contexts.
responsiveBehavior: Form fields normally fill their parent; use hug width only in a compact toolbar or filter layout with an explicit width constraint.
Choose density from the containing layout: md for ordinary forms, lg for a touch-primary layout, and sm or xs only where surrounding controls use the same compact recipe.
The owner supplies layout constraints and decides when a compact field moves to its own row.

customElements: Listen for dsChange for user edits and dsClear for the search clear action.
Use the form attribute on the host when associating an input rendered outside its owning form.
react: Use DsInput, bind value for controlled application state, and handle onDsChange and onDsClear.
vue: Use DsInput with v-model for the value, and listen for dsChange and dsClear.
angular: Import DsInput with TextValueAccessor when integrating with Angular Forms.

ariaActiveDescendant.description: Identifies the active descendant while focus remains in the editable field.

ariaControls.description: Identifies the results or popup controlled by the editable field.

hasBorder.description: Show the standard inset border, including focused and invalid strokes.

hasInteractionFill.description: Show the standard hover and pressed fill when the field is not embedded in interactive chrome.

inputId.description: Associates the internal input with an external <label>.

inputMode.description: Preferred virtual keyboard without changing the value semantics.

max.description: Maximum accepted value when type is number.

min.description: Minimum accepted value when type is number.

readOnly.description: Keeps the value focusable and submittable while preventing edits.

step.description: Numeric increment used by native stepping and constraint validation.

textAlign.description: Align the editable value; number steppers follow the same inline edge.

width.description: Width fit — fill the parent (default) or hug the available content.
